description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling RetrieveThingDefinition commands within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically retrieving and processing Thing definitions.

classes.name: RetrieveThingDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: Implements the command strategy for retrieving Thing definitions, handling the logic for processing the command and generating results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval logic for a given context, Thing, and command, returning a Result containing a ThingEvent or an error.

methods.name: extractDefinition
methods.description: Extracts the ThingDefinition from a given Thing, throwing an exception if not accessible.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous EntityTag for the given command and previous entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next EntityTag based on the new entity's definition.
